1. (Currently amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product; and __automatically alerting a user when the generated at least use information indicates a deviation from a predicted usage pattern__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __scanning__ the unique identifier from the package.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises receiving information stored in __and wirelessly transmitted from__ a radio frequency identification tag.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __querying and retrieving from__ a data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier __to obtain user-specific historical usage data__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4, wherein __querying and retrieving from__ the data store comprises transmitting the unique identifier to the data store over a network __and receiving a response containing the at least use information__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and converting the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form __customized for display to the user__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __retrieving and displaying__ the at least use information from the data store __to the user on a user device__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises __a personalized medication schedule indicating__ at least one of when a next dose of the product is to be taken, when a previous dose of a product was taken, and if a dose of the product is to be taken.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __actively soliciting and__ receiving user information regarding use of the product from a user __through a user interface__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving an input through a user device __in real-time or near real-time__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving the user information regarding use of the product __transmitted from__ a radio frequency identification tag __associated with the user__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving __sensor data__ from a secondary device __configured to monitor product usage__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, an identification bracelet, a user information medium __and a secure user database__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing past use information associated with the unique identifier to an authorized individual __only upon verification of authorization credentials__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving a user profile, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information based at least partially on __both__ the user profile __and real-time user input__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising generating an alert regarding use of the product based at least partially on __a comparison of__ stored user information regarding past use of the product __with current usage data__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is an escalating alert and wherein the form of the alert escalates with each time no response to the alert is received __within a predetermined time interval__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is customized by at least one of a user and an authorized individual __based on user preferences or clinical guidelines__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying __a caregiver or administrator__ providing the product.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: comparing at least one of a first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier to at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or a user identifier associated with the first unique identifier; and generating a wrong user alert if the at least one of the first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier does not match the at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or the user identifier associated with the first unique identifier __and the mismatch exceeds a confidence threshold__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, further comprising generating one or more escalating wrong user alerts when a previous wrong user alert is not acknowledged __within a specified time period__.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, wherein the user comprises a first user and the second unique identifier identifies a second user providing the product to the first user, the method further comprising: storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user __including timestamp and dosage information__.

23. (Currently amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of the second user __based on their authorization level__.

24. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for __a specific user based on their medical history and preferences__.

25. (Currently amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing the product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the user device further configured to communicate with a data store, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier and at least part of the at least use information, __wherein the user device further comprises a processor configured to automatically compare current usage patterns against historical usage data and generate alerts when deviations are detected__.

26. (Currently amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, the computing device further configured to communicate with a network __and to automatically monitor and alert users of usage deviations__.

27. (Currently amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: __a processor configured to receive__ a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and __the processor further configured to generate__ at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

28. (Currently amended) A computer readable storage medium on which is embedded one or more computer programs, said one or more computer programs implementing a method of providing information regarding a product, said one or more computer programs comprising a set of instructions for: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product __and automatically comparing the generated information against predicted usage patterns to identify deviations__.
